name.zh: 丹东—锡林浩特高速公路

tagline.en: From the Yellow Sea coast near Dandong across Liaoning and Chifeng to the Xilingol grassland
tagline.zh: 从丹东附近的黄海岸边，横穿辽宁与赤峰，直抵锡林郭勒草原

start.en: Aobaoshan roundabout on Xilinhot's South Second Ring Road at Hanggai Road, Xilingol League, Inner Mongolia — kilometre 942
start.zh: 内蒙古自治区锡林郭勒盟锡林浩特市南二环路与杭盖路交口敖包山环岛——942 公里处

end.en: Dagushan West interchange with G11 in Donggang, Dandong, Liaoning — kilometre 0
end.zh: 辽宁省丹东市东港市大孤山西枢纽，接 G11 鹤大高速——零公里点

en: G16 runs north-west for 942 km on the national chainage in the Chinese Wikipedia exit list, from the Yellow Sea coast to the Mongolian plateau; Xilingol's transport bureau gives 960 km, the length used in the plan. Despite the name it does not enter Dandong: it begins at a junction with G11 at Dagushan in Donggang, about 80 km from the city along G11, and runs north-west through Xiuyan to Haicheng, then west to Panjin.

From Panjin to Jinzhou it runs on G1 for about 80 km. It then turns inland by Chaoyang and Jianping, crosses the Laoha River into Inner Mongolia, and passes Chifeng, where it shares the city ring road and G45. North of Chifeng it climbs through Hexigten Banner by Jingpeng and Dali Nur onto the grassland of Xilingol. Liaoning has 500 km and Inner Mongolia 442. Xilingol presented the last section as an important route for the league to the frontier and to the sea.
zh: 据中文维基百科出口列表，G16 按国家里程桩号全长 942 公里，自黄海岸边向西北直上蒙古高原；锡林郭勒盟交通运输局给出的是规划里程 960 公里。虽名为丹锡，它并不进入丹东市区：起点在东港市大孤山与 G11 相交的枢纽，沿 G11 距丹东城区约 80 公里；由此向西北经岫岩至海城，再向西至盘锦。
盘锦至锦州约 80 公里与 G1 京哈高速共线。此后折向内陆，经朝阳、建平，跨过老哈河进入内蒙古，经赤峰，与赤峰绕城高速及 G45 大广高速共线。赤峰以北经克什克腾旗经棚、达里诺尔爬上锡林郭勒草原。辽宁段 500 公里，内蒙古段 442 公里。锡林郭勒盟把最后一段称为本盟“通疆达海”的重要通道。

en: It is a four-lane road throughout, mostly designed for 100 km/h on a 26-metre roadbed. The heaviest construction is at the eastern end: the 143 km from Dagushan through Xiuyan to Haicheng needed 50 large and extra-large bridges, 34 medium bridges, eleven interchanges and seven tunnels.
The Daban–Jingpeng section, the last to be built, kept a 25.5-metre roadbed, and about 91 km of second- and third-class service roads were restored alongside it as part of the same project.
zh: 全线为双向四车道，大部分路段设计时速 100 公里，路基宽 26 米。工程量最大的是东端：大孤山经岫岩至海城 143 公里，设特大桥、大桥 50 座，中桥 34 座，互通式立交 11 座，隧道 7 座。
最后修建的大板至经棚段路基宽度维持 25.5 米，并按二、三级公路标准同步实施约 91 公里辅道恢复工程。

en: The road was assembled from regional projects, starting in the middle. Panjin–Haicheng, half of a Y-shaped expressway linking the Beijing–Shenyang and Shenyang–Dalian roads, was begun in November 1999 and opened on 23 August 2002. Jinzhou–Chaoyang, Chaoyang's first expressway, was built from 2002 and opened in 2005. In Inner Mongolia, Chifeng–Daban, about 150 km, was begun in 2005 and opened on 6 December 2007; with the Chifeng–Tongliao expressway, opened two months earlier, it was Chifeng's first.

Liaoning's Chaoyang–Heishui section to the Laoha River opened on 27 September 2010, and Dandong (Dagushan)–Haicheng, begun in October 2008, on 17 September 2011, with the last 18 km to Haicheng on 1 October. Chifeng–Pingzhuang, 46 km on the Inner Mongolia side, was expected to open at the end of October 2011.

The northern end came last. Jingpeng–Xilinhot, 138 km, was begun in Chifeng on 12 August 2013 and in Xilingol in July 2014, and opened on 18 March 2017. The gap between Daban and Jingpeng, 113.5 km, approved by the National Development and Reform Commission in June 2015 and begun in April 2016, opened on 1 August 2019, completing G16.
zh: 这条路由各地项目拼接而成，最先修的是中段。盘锦至海城段是连接京沈、沈大两条高速公路的“Y”字形盘海营高速的一半，1999 年 11 月开工，2002 年 8 月 23 日通车。锦州至朝阳段是朝阳第一条高速公路，2002 年开工，2005 年通车。内蒙古境内，赤峰至大板段约 150 公里，2005 年开工，2007 年 12 月 6 日通车，与两个月前通车的赤通高速一道，结束了赤峰没有高速公路的历史。
辽宁朝阳至黑水（老哈河）段于 2010 年 9 月 27 日通车；2008 年 10 月开工的丹东（大孤山）至海城段于 2011 年 9 月 17 日通车，至海城的最后 18 公里于 10 月 1 日通车。内蒙古一侧 46 公里的赤峰至平庄段预计于 2011 年 10 月底通车。
北端最后建成。经棚至锡林浩特段 138 公里，赤峰境内于 2013 年 8 月 12 日开工，锡盟境内于 2014 年 7 月开工，2017 年 3 月 18 日通车。剩下的大板至经棚段 113.5 公里，2015 年 6 月获国家发展改革委批复，2016 年 4 月开工，2019 年 8 月 1 日通车，G16 全线贯通。

en: No cost for the whole road has been published. The largest single figure is 6.343 billion yuan for Dagushan–Haicheng; the Chaoyang–Heishui section cost 3.5 billion, Chifeng–Daban nearly 3 billion and Jingpeng–Xilinhot was estimated at 6.11 billion.

The clearest funding breakdown is for Daban–Jingpeng. Of an estimated 2.846 billion yuan, the state put in 870 million from the central vehicle-purchase-tax fund and Inner Mongolia 140 million from its key-road fund, together about 35 per cent, as the project's equity; the rest was borrowed from domestic banks. The road is tolled.
zh: 全线没有公开的总造价。最大的一笔是大孤山至海城段的 63.43 亿元；朝阳至黑水段 35 亿元，赤峰至大板段近 30 亿元，经棚至锡林浩特段估算 61.1 亿元。
资金构成最清楚的是大板至经棚段：估算总投资 28.46 亿元中，国家安排中央专项建设基金（车购税）8.7 亿元，自治区安排重点公路建设专项资金 1.4 亿元，共 10.1 亿元作为项目资本金，约占 35%；其余利用国内银行贷款。全线收费。

why.en: No total has been published. G16 was built by Liaoning and Inner Mongolia as about nine separately financed projects between 1999 and 2019, and costs are reported per project; sourced section figures are given below. No cost was found for Panjin–Haicheng or Jinzhou–Chaoyang.
why.zh: 全线没有公开的总造价。G16 由辽宁和内蒙古在 1999 至 2019 年间分约九个项目分别筹资建设，造价按项目公布；下列为有来源的分段数字。盘海段、锦朝段未查到造价。

value.en: Dandong (Dagushan)–Haicheng, 143.1 km: 6.343 billion yuan (2008–2011). Chaoyang–Heishui, 103.7 km including 8.6 km in Inner Mongolia: 3.5 billion (2007–2010).

figures.source: Liaoning Provincial Department of Transport, 13 October 2011; Northeast News Net, 28 September 2010, via Sina

value.en: Chifeng–Daban, about 150 km: nearly 3 billion yuan (2005–2007). Chifeng–Pingzhuang, 46 km: 1.998 billion (due to open late 2011). Jingpeng–Xilinhot, 138 km: 6.11 billion estimated in 2013, of which the 72.6 km in Xilingol 3.597 billion. Daban–Jingpeng, 113.5 km: 2.846 billion estimated at approval in 2015.
value.zh: 赤峰至大板段约 150 公里近 30 亿元（2005—2007）；赤峰至平庄段 46 公里 19.98 亿元（预计 2011 年底通车）；经棚至锡林浩特段 138 公里，2013 年估算 61.1 亿元，其中锡盟境内 72.6 公里 35.97 亿元；大板至经棚段 113.5 公里，2015 年批复估算 28.46 亿元。

figures.source: China National Radio (Inner Mongolia), 6 December 2007; Xinhua, via 9to.com, 19 September 2011; Inner Mongolia News, 14 August 2013; Xilingol League Development and Reform Commission, 17 March 2016; 9to.com, on NDRC approval 发改基础〔2015〕1211号

value.en: Liaoning and Inner Mongolia, section by section, repaid from tolls. For Daban–Jingpeng: 870 million yuan of central vehicle-purchase-tax funds and 140 million of regional key-road funds as equity (about 35 per cent), the rest domestic bank loans.
value.zh: 辽宁、内蒙古分段出资，以通行费还贷。大板至经棚段：中央车购税资金 8.7 亿元、自治区重点公路建设专项资金 1.4 亿元作为资本金（约 35%），其余为国内银行贷款。

figures.source: 9to.com, on NDRC approval 发改基础〔2015〕1211号, 2015

value.en: 942 km on the national chainage: 500 km in Liaoning, 442 km in Inner Mongolia. Xilingol's transport bureau and China Daily give 960 km.
value.zh: 按国家里程桩号 942 公里：辽宁 500 公里，内蒙古 442 公里。锡林郭勒盟交通运输局及中国日报网作 960 公里。

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 丹东－锡林浩特高速公路; Xilingol League Transport Bureau, March 2017; China Daily (Chinese), 8 August 2019

timeline.zh: 8 月 23 日，盘锦至海城段通车。

timeline.en: The national expressway plan numbers the line G16; Jinzhou–Chaoyang opens.
timeline.zh: 国家高速公路网规划将该线编为 G16；锦朝高速通车。
12 月 6 日，赤峰至大板段通车。

timeline.en: Chaoyang–Heishui opens on 27 September, reaching the Inner Mongolia line.
timeline.zh: 9 月 27 日，朝阳至黑水段通车，抵达辽蒙界。
9 月 17 日，丹东（大孤山）至海城段通车。

timeline.en: Work on Jingpeng–Xilinhot begins on 12 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 12 日，经棚至锡林浩特段开工。
3 月 18 日，经棚至锡林浩特段通车。

timeline.en: Daban–Jingpeng opens on 1 August, completing G16.
timeline.zh: 8 月 1 日，大板至经棚段通车，G16 全线贯通。
